values.title: Hello World
values.body:
Hello World!

Welcome to your new Decoupled Drupal space. This is your first piece of content, created to demonstrate the power of the Decoupled platform.

You can edit this content through the Drupal admin interface or create new content types and pages as needed.

values.title: Welcome
values.body:
Welcome to Decoupled

This starter project demonstrates how to build a Next.js frontend connected to a Drupal backend.

Getting Started

Explore the pages and content to understand how the integration works.

values.title: About
values.body:
About This Project

This is a decoupled Drupal project using Next.js as the frontend framework.

The content is managed in Drupal and consumed via APIs to render on the Next.js frontend.
